The Strong Survive#320.dst: Podia ser melhor, mas o treino serve justamente para revelar nossas fraquezas.
The Strong Survive#320.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#321.src: Wow, that Adder guy sure is something...
The Strong Survive#321.dst: Nossa, esse tal de Adder é outro nível...
The Strong Survive#321.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#322.src: I shouldn't be surprised though, him and Saldin are on a different level from the rest of us.
The Strong Survive#322.dst: Mas não devia me surpreender, ele e o Saldin estão num nível acima do resto de nós.
The Strong Survive#322.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#323.src: I too will reach that level soon, I will prove my worth to the Commander!
The Strong Survive#323.dst: Também vou chegar a esse nível logo, vou provar meu valor ao comandante!
The Strong Survive#323.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#324.src: Look at that disappointment moping in the corner, I think {~}th place suits him well.
The Strong Survive#324.dst: Olha aquele fracasso choramingando no canto, acho que o {~}º lugar combina com ele.
The Strong Survive#324.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#325.src: Arnol? Well... It was only the first day. He could improve...
The Strong Survive#325.dst: O Arnol? Bem... Foi só o primeiro dia. Ele pode melhorar...
The Strong Survive#325.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#326.src: What?! Oh wait... You didn't do too well either, did you?
The Strong Survive#326.dst: O quê?! Ah, espera... Você também não foi muito bem, né?
The Strong Survive#326.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#327.src: How could I have ranked so low? I must try harder to show my worth as a soldier!
The Strong Survive#327.dst: Como fiquei tão atrás? Tenho que me esforçar e provar meu valor como soldado!
The Strong Survive#327.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#328.src: I hope Recruiter Olissy will forgive me for this...
The Strong Survive#328.dst: Espero que a recrutadora Olissy me perdoe...
The Strong Survive#328.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#329.src: Looks like brawn beats brains again, huh sis?
The Strong Survive#329.dst: Músculo vence cérebro de novo, hein, mana?
The Strong Survive#329.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#330.src: More like luck beats brains! If our training was more realistic then everyone would see that I am clearly better.
The Strong Survive#330.dst: Sorte vence cérebro, isso sim! Se o treino fosse mais realista, todos veriam que sou claramente melhor.
The Strong Survive#330.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#331.src: It is just as I expected. Despite it being the first day, many recruits struggled catastrophically in their training.
The Strong Survive#331.dst: É bem o que eu esperava. Mesmo sendo o primeiro dia, muitos recrutas fracassaram de forma catastrófica no treino.
The Strong Survive#331.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#332.src: Their scores will only go down from here. I doubt any of them have the will to dig themselves out from the dirt.
The Strong Survive#332.dst: As notas deles só vão cair daqui em diante. Duvido que algum tenha força de vontade para sair da lama.
The Strong Survive#332.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#333.src: I wonder how long it will be until something is done about this.
The Strong Survive#333.dst: Quanto tempo será que vai levar até fazerem algo a respeito?
The Strong Survive#333.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#334.src: Hey {u}. It feels like it's been a while since we've last seen each other.
The Strong Survive#334.dst: Oi, {u}. Parece que faz tempo que não nos vemos.
The Strong Survive#334.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#335.src: It's been a long day, I feel so tired already. Heh, it's pathetic...
The Strong Survive#335.dst: Foi um dia longo, já estou exausto. Heh, que patético...
The Strong Survive#335.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#336.src: I've been avoiding it because it's embarrassing, but I think you deserve to know.
The Strong Survive#336.dst: Eu vinha evitando porque é vergonhoso, mas acho que você merece saber.
The Strong Survive#336.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#337.src: Regarding what happened in the cafeteria, another recruit and I were taken to the guard barracks.
The Strong Survive#337.dst: Sobre o que houve no refeitório: eu e outro recruta fomos levados ao quartel da guarda.
The Strong Survive#337.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#338.src: They wanted the room to be spotless before the end of the day... It was a punishment for not doing well enough on the training.
The Strong Survive#338.dst: Queriam o lugar impecável até o fim do dia... Era um castigo por não termos ido bem o bastante no treino.
The Strong Survive#338.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#339.src: After that, they took me to the dueling room, an instructor hastily explained what to do. And, well... The duel didn't last very long...
The Strong Survive#339.dst: Depois me levaram à sala de duelos, e um instrutor explicou às pressas o que fazer. E, bem... O duelo não durou muito...
The Strong Survive#339.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#340.src: I just wished they would give me more of a chance to prove myself. I know I can do better!
The Strong Survive#340.dst: Queria só que me dessem mais chances de provar meu valor. Sei que posso fazer melhor!
The Strong Survive#340.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#341.src: This isn't what I expected Tericen to be like. It feels absurd to subject your recruits to that on the first day!
The Strong Survive#341.dst: Não imaginava Tericen assim. É absurdo submeter os recrutas a isso logo no primeiro dia!
The Strong Survive#341.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#342.src: There's something I want to tell you in a more private area {u}. Before you go to bed, talk to me in the barracks.
The Strong Survive#342.dst: Quero te contar uma coisa num lugar mais reservado, {u}. Antes de dormir, fale comigo no quartel.
The Strong Survive#342.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#343.src: Speak to Arnol in the barracks, then go to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#343.dst: Fale com Arnol no quartel e depois vá dormir em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#344.src: You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
The Strong Survive#344.dst: Por hoje acabou, não há mais desafios.
The Strong Survive#344.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#345.src: Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
The Strong Survive#345.dst: Agora vá descansar, você merece. Ao entrar na próxima sala, siga até a sala bem em frente e, de lá, entre na sala à esquerda.
The Strong Survive#345.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#347.src: So how do you feel about all of this after the first day?
The Strong Survive#347.dst: E aí, o que achou de tudo isso depois do primeiro dia?
The Strong Survive#347.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#348.src: It was alright, I don't see the point in the ranking system though, we're all going to become soldiers in the end.
The Strong Survive#348.dst: Foi tranquilo, mas não vejo sentido na classificação; no fim, todos vamos virar soldados.
The Strong Survive#348.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#349.src: It's just something to keep us engaged, to make sure everyone is doing their best in the training I think.
The Strong Survive#349.dst: Acho que é só para nos manter motivados, para todos darem o melhor no treino.
The Strong Survive#349.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#350.src: You lied to me... Don't ever think about talking to me again until you get at least {~}rd place in the rankings!
The Strong Survive#350.dst: Você mentiu para mim... Nem pense em falar comigo de novo até ficar pelo menos em {~}º lugar na classificação!
The Strong Survive#350.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#351.src: I'm sorry! I was just too embarrassed to tell you the truth!
The Strong Survive#351.dst: Desculpa! Eu só tive vergonha demais de contar a verdade!
The Strong Survive#351.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#352.src: I-I can make up for this! Please! I don't want to be alone here!
The Strong Survive#352.dst: E-eu compenso! Por favor! Não quero ficar sem ninguém aqui!
The Strong Survive#352.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#353.src: Are you here to humiliate me further? Go ahead, laugh, I don't care!
The Strong Survive#353.dst: Veio me humilhar mais? Vá em frente, ria, não ligo!
The Strong Survive#353.speaker: Katze

The Strong Survive#354.src: I'll make you and everyone else who mocked me eat their words!
The Strong Survive#354.dst: Você e todos que riram de mim vão engolir o que falaram!
The Strong Survive#354.speaker: Katze

The Strong Survive#355.src: I'll become stronger, stronger than all of you! I-I just need more time.
The Strong Survive#355.dst: Vou ficar mais forte, mais que todos vocês! S-só preciso de mais tempo.
The Strong Survive#355.speaker: Katze

The Strong Survive#357.src: I want to apologize to you {u}. Earlier today, when I told you my reason for wanting to become a soldier, I lied.
The Strong Survive#357.dst: Quero te pedir desculpas, {u}. Hoje cedo, quando contei por que queria ser soldado, eu menti.
The Strong Survive#357.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#358.src: I didn't come to {p} out of any noble duty to serve Fruma. I came here because it was a last resort for me.
The Strong Survive#358.dst: Não vim a {p} por nenhum nobre dever de servir Fruma. Vim porque era meu último recurso.
The Strong Survive#358.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#359.src: I originally wanted to become a scholar at the royal university. If I were a member of a more powerful house, I would have been accepted in, no question.
The Strong Survive#359.dst: Eu queria ser estudioso na universidade real. Se fosse de uma casa mais poderosa, teria sido aceito sem discussão.
The Strong Survive#359.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#360.src: They made me take a test to be let in, and I failed it. On top of that, they refused to let me retake it.
The Strong Survive#360.dst: Me fizeram prestar uma prova de admissão, e fui reprovado. Ainda por cima, não me deixaram refazer.
The Strong Survive#360.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#361.src: My father was furious with me, he was concerned with how I could bring honour to our house. So he turned to his friends in the military.
The Strong Survive#361.dst: Meu pai ficou furioso; estava preocupado com como eu traria honra à nossa casa. Então recorreu aos amigos dele no exército.
The Strong Survive#361.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#362.src: He pulled some strings, and here I am, becoming a soldier in order to bring more respect to house Tasa.
The Strong Survive#362.dst: Ele mexeu uns pauzinhos, e aqui estou eu, virando soldado para trazer mais respeito à casa Tasa.
The Strong Survive#362.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#363.src: I am not telling you this because I want you to pity me. I want you to know why this is so important to me.
The Strong Survive#363.dst: Não estou contando para que tenha pena de mim. Quero que saiba por que isso é tão importante para mim.
The Strong Survive#363.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#364.src: If word went around that a member of house Tasa was forced to clean the guard barracks as a punishment...
The Strong Survive#364.dst: Se espalhassem que um membro da casa Tasa foi obrigado a limpar o quartel da guarda como castigo...
The Strong Survive#364.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#365.src: Well... Everything my father has done for me could be wasted, and I would be an even bigger failure than before...
The Strong Survive#365.dst: Bem... Tudo o que meu pai fez por mim podia ir por água abaixo, e eu seria um fracasso ainda maior...
The Strong Survive#365.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#366.src: That's all I wanted to tell you. I hope you can understand why I lied to you, I just didn't know if I could trust you with this, but now I do.
The Strong Survive#366.dst: Era isso que eu queria contar. Espero que entenda por que menti; eu não sabia se podia te confiar isso, mas agora sei.
The Strong Survive#366.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#367.src: Sneak around to find information on the Fruman military.
The Strong Survive#367.dst: Explore às escondidas em busca de informações sobre o exército de Fruma.

The Strong Survive#369.src: So how did it go, is Verdi alright?
The Strong Survive#369.dst: E então, como foi? O Verdi está bem?
The Strong Survive#369.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#370.src: I'm afraid not Commander, his injuries are severe. I recommend sending him home to recover.
The Strong Survive#370.dst: Receio que não, comandante, os ferimentos são graves. Recomendo mandá-lo para casa.
The Strong Survive#370.speaker: Military Doctor

The Strong Survive#371.src: Maybe after he regains his former strength, he will be able to rejoin the program, but it's difficult to say...
The Strong Survive#371.dst: Talvez, ao recuperar as forças, ele possa voltar ao programa, mas é difícil dizer...
The Strong Survive#371.speaker: Military Doctor

The Strong Survive#372.src: To think that this damage was done with a training sword... It's... Incredible.
The Strong Survive#372.dst: E pensar que esse estrago foi feito com uma espada de treino... É... Incrível.
The Strong Survive#372.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#373.src: What do you think should be done, Commander, should Adder be punished for harming a fellow recruit?
The Strong Survive#373.dst: O que acha que devemos fazer, comandante? O Adder deve ser punido por ferir um colega?
The Strong Survive#373.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#374.src: No. This is an opportunity, Strumon, one that I do not want to let slip. Verdi will be sent home, and that recruit of your's will not be punished, but praised.
The Strong Survive#374.dst: Não. Isto é uma oportunidade, Strumon, e não quero deixá-la escapar. Verdi volta para casa, e aquele seu recruta não será punido, mas elogiado.
The Strong Survive#374.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#375.src: If Majin wants better results, this is how we do that... Just make sure to keep Adder in line, we don't want him going too far.
The Strong Survive#375.dst: Se o Majin quer resultados melhores, é assim que se consegue... Só mantenha o Adder na linha, para ele não passar dos limites.
The Strong Survive#375.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#376.src: Who is that? Is someone watching us?...
The Strong Survive#376.dst: Quem está aí? Alguém está nos vigiando?...
The Strong Survive#376.speaker: Military Doctor

The Strong Survive#377.src: Quickly run back to your bed at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#377.dst: Corra de volta para sua cama em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#379.src: Tell Arnol what you heard last night.
The Strong Survive#379.dst: Conte a Arnol o que você ouviu ontem à noite.

The Strong Survive#380.src: Hey, {u}, are you awake? You slept through the alarm bell.
The Strong Survive#380.dst: Ei, {u}, acordou? Você nem ouviu o sino de alarme.
The Strong Survive#380.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#381.src: Everyone has already gone to start the training for today, I told Effal that I'd wake you up.
The Strong Survive#381.dst: Todo mundo já foi começar o treino de hoje; eu disse ao Effal que acordaria você.
The Strong Survive#381.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#382.src: What! A recruit was injured so badly during the dueling training they had to be sent home?!
The Strong Survive#382.dst: O quê?! Um recruta se feriu tanto no treino de duelo que teve que ser mandado para casa?!
The Strong Survive#382.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#383.src: It must have been an accident, maybe Adder forgot to hold back? I've heard people say that the strength of one Wings soldier is equal to three regional soldiers.
The Strong Survive#383.dst: Deve ter sido acidente, talvez o Adder tenha esquecido de se conter? Dizem que um soldado das Asas vale por três soldados regionais.
The Strong Survive#383.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#384.src: This doesn't seem right, {u}... Why would Commander Ferreo see that as an "opportunity"? What could that mean...
The Strong Survive#384.dst: Isso não está certo, {u}... Por que o comandante Ferreo veria isso como uma "oportunidade"? O que quer dizer...
The Strong Survive#384.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#385.src: We have to get down to the bottom of this. How about we confront Adder during lunch, and ask him what happened during his duel on the first day.
The Strong Survive#385.dst: Precisamos ir a fundo nisso. Que tal confrontarmos o Adder no almoço e perguntar o que houve no duelo dele no primeiro dia.
The Strong Survive#385.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#386.src: But we need to get going now, I imagine Effal and the other recruits aren't happy waiting for us. Follow me, I'll lead you to the training room.
The Strong Survive#386.dst: Mas agora temos que ir; imagino que o Effal e os outros não estejam felizes esperando a gente. Me siga, vou levar você à sala de treino.
The Strong Survive#386.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#387.src: Go to your first challenge, then listen to the challenge instructions at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#387.dst: Vá ao seu primeiro desafio e ouça as instruções em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#388.src: All of the other recruits are probably in their challenge rooms right now.
The Strong Survive#388.dst: Os outros recrutas já devem estar nas salas de desafio agora.
The Strong Survive#388.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#389.src: You should join them. Head to the endurance training room, it's the same one as yesterday.
The Strong Survive#389.dst: Vá se juntar a eles. Siga para a sala de treino de resistência, a mesma de ontem.
The Strong Survive#389.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#390.src: Things aren't going to be as easy today, good luck!
The Strong Survive#390.dst: Hoje não vai ser tão fácil, boa sorte!
The Strong Survive#390.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#391.src: Well, it looks like we can start now that everyone's here.
The Strong Survive#391.dst: Bem, parece que agora que estão todos aqui podemos começar.
The Strong Survive#391.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#392.src: Most of you did well on the first course, so we're going to be upping the difficulty this time. I trust that you're all ready.
The Strong Survive#392.dst: A maioria foi bem no primeiro circuito, então desta vez vamos aumentar a dificuldade. Confio que estejam todos prontos.
The Strong Survive#392.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#393.src: Make sure to watch where you're going, this course will have false platforms to trick you up if you're not paying attention.
The Strong Survive#393.dst: Olhem bem por onde andam: este circuito tem plataformas falsas para enganar quem não estiver atento.
The Strong Survive#393.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#394.src: Like before, you'll be judged based on how quickly you can complete the course and reach the exit.
The Strong Survive#394.dst: Como antes, vocês serão avaliados pela rapidez com que completarem o circuito e chegarem à saída.
The Strong Survive#394.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#395.src: I left the jump pad in here in case you want to get used to the feeling again. Enter the large door behind me to start the course when you're ready.
The Strong Survive#395.dst: Deixei o trampolim aqui caso queiram se acostumar de novo. Quando estiverem prontos, entrem pela porta grande atrás de mim.
The Strong Survive#395.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#396.src: Complete the first challenge of the day.
The Strong Survive#396.dst: Complete o primeiro desafio do dia.

The Strong Survive#397.src: You realize your bad behaviour makes me look even worse for bringing you in, right?
The Strong Survive#397.dst: Percebe que seu mau comportamento me queima ainda mais por ter trazido você, né?
The Strong Survive#397.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#398.src: If I catch you sleeping in, going where you're not supposed to, or doing anything out of line again... You'll come to regret it...
The Strong Survive#398.dst: Se eu te pegar dormindo demais, indo aonde não deve ou saindo da linha de novo... Vai se arrepender...
The Strong Survive#398.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#399.src: I've been disgraced by my friends for getting ranked low yesterday... Now I don't feel like I have the will to do anything...
The Strong Survive#399.dst: Meus amigos me humilharam por eu ter ido mal ontem... Agora não tenho vontade de fazer nada...
The Strong Survive#399.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#400.src: D-Do you think I could regain their trust by getting a high ranking? No... I'm still not strong enough...
The Strong Survive#400.dst: A-acha que eu reconquistaria a confiança deles ficando bem colocado? Não... Ainda me falta força...
The Strong Survive#400.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#401.src: This is the challenge I did the best on yesterday. It should be mostly the same, hopefully. Slow and steady wins the race.
The Strong Survive#401.dst: Este é o desafio em que fui melhor ontem. Tomara que seja quase igual. Devagar se vai ao longe.
The Strong Survive#401.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#402.src: I'm not going to rush into these challenges like yesterday, I need time to think about what I am going to do.
The Strong Survive#402.dst: Não vou me jogar nesses desafios como ontem, preciso de tempo para pensar no que vou fazer.
The Strong Survive#402.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#403.src: Took you a while to find your way here, did you get lost or something?
The Strong Survive#403.dst: Demorou para achar o caminho, hein? Se perdeu, foi?
The Strong Survive#403.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#404.src: You're lucky Effal is a pushover, if you were in my group, you'd be out of here without a second thought.
The Strong Survive#404.dst: Sorte sua que o Effal é molenga; se estivesse no meu grupo, já estaria fora daqui sem pensar duas vezes.
The Strong Survive#404.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#405.dst: Sua vez, {u}, dê o seu melhor!
The Strong Survive#405.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#406.src: Enter the next room and receive instructions for the next challenge.
The Strong Survive#406.dst: Entre na próxima sala e receba as instruções do próximo desafio.

The Strong Survive#407.src: Not a bad time you had there. Keep this up and you might end up making me no longer regret letting you in here.
The Strong Survive#407.dst: Nada mal esse tempo. Continue assim e talvez eu pare de me arrepender de ter trazido você.
The Strong Survive#407.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#408.src: Up next is shield training, you're still not out of the woods yet. We are expecting big things from you.
The Strong Survive#408.dst: Agora é o treino de escudo, você ainda não está a salvo. Esperamos grandes coisas de você.
The Strong Survive#408.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#409.src: Well... That was a disappointment. You've been given many second chances and this is what you do to give thanks?
The Strong Survive#409.dst: Bem... Que decepção. Você recebeu várias segundas chances e é assim que agradece?
The Strong Survive#409.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#410.src: If your mediocrity persists, I'll have no choice but to let you go, for both of our sake's. Now follow me to the next training room.
The Strong Survive#410.dst: Se essa mediocridade continuar, não terei escolha a não ser te dispensar, pelo bem de nós dois. Agora me siga até a próxima sala.
The Strong Survive#410.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#411.src: Hey {u}, I think the challenge went well. I managed to complete it at least, although I can't say for certain if I made good time.
The Strong Survive#411.dst: Ei, {u}, acho que o desafio foi bem. Pelo menos consegui completar, mas não sei dizer se fiz um bom tempo.
The Strong Survive#411.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#412.src: I couldn't help but feel off about what the instructor said when I started the course... "Good luck Arnol... Not that it would matter...".
The Strong Survive#412.dst: Fiquei incomodado com o que o instrutor disse quando comecei o circuito... "Boa sorte, Arnol... Não que vá fazer diferença...".
The Strong Survive#412.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#413.src: What is that supposed to mean? I thought instructors were supposed to encourage us, helping us do better in the training.
The Strong Survive#413.dst: O que isso quer dizer? Achei que os instrutores deviam nos encorajar e ajudar a melhorar no treino.
The Strong Survive#413.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#414.src: I'm beginning to think that this training program is more about shaming us rather than preparing us to become soldiers. I wonder if the other recruits are starting to believe this as well...
The Strong Survive#414.dst: Estou começando a achar que esse programa serve mais para nos humilhar do que para nos preparar para ser soldados. Será que os outros recrutas também estão achando isso...
The Strong Survive#414.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#415.src: Welcome recruits to day two of your training in the shield challenge.
The Strong Survive#415.dst: Bem-vindos, recrutas, ao segundo dia do desafio do escudo.
The Strong Survive#415.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#416.src: I'll keep the summary short since I'm sure most of you remember the gist of the test from yesterday.
The Strong Survive#416.dst: Vou ser breve, pois a maioria deve lembrar o essencial da prova de ontem.
The Strong Survive#416.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#417.src: This time, instead of three turrets shooting at you, the number has been upped to five.
The Strong Survive#417.dst: Desta vez, em vez de três torretas atirando em vocês, serão cinco.
The Strong Survive#417.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#418.src: On top of that, the three central turrets have been elevated. You'll have to aim your shield higher to block arrows coming from them.
The Strong Survive#418.dst: Além disso, as três torretas centrais foram elevadas. Vocês terão que erguer o escudo mais alto para bloquear as flechas delas.
The Strong Survive#418.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#419.src: I've also adjusted the turret timings a little. Two turrets are now able to fire at you in quick succession, you must be ready to block the arrows from both of them.
The Strong Survive#419.dst: Também ajustei um pouco o tempo das torretas. Agora duas podem atirar em sequência rápida, então estejam prontos para bloquear as flechas das duas.
The Strong Survive#419.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#420.src: I noticed that some of you struggled with lifting the shield on the first day...
The Strong Survive#420.dst: Notei que alguns tiveram dificuldade até para erguer o escudo no primeiro dia...
The Strong Survive#420.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#421.src: Perhaps those people would like some sort of crutch to help them perform better, but I must say that no such thing will be granted.
The Strong Survive#421.dst: Talvez essas pessoas queiram alguma muleta para se sair melhor, mas devo dizer que nada disso será concedido.
The Strong Survive#421.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#422.src: I believe that failure can be an excellent teacher. Some of you may still need to learn that failure should elicit a change from yourself.
The Strong Survive#422.dst: Acredito que o fracasso pode ser um ótimo professor. Alguns ainda precisam aprender que o fracasso deve provocar uma mudança em si mesmos.
The Strong Survive#422.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#423.src: For those recruits, until this lesson is fully learned, continued failure will be far more valuable than success.
The Strong Survive#423.dst: Para esses recrutas, até aprenderem bem essa lição, continuar fracassando valerá muito mais que o sucesso.
The Strong Survive#423.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#424.src: With that being said, I wish all of you luck on the challenge! Pick up a shield on the rack next to Recruiter Ezero if you haven't.
The Strong Survive#424.dst: Dito isso, desejo boa sorte a todos no desafio! Quem não tem escudo, pegue um no suporte ao lado do recrutador Ezero.
The Strong Survive#424.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#425.src: Then, once you're ready, enter the large door behind me to start the test. Oh, and the training turret is still here if you need it.
The Strong Survive#425.dst: Depois, quando estiverem prontos, entrem pela porta grande atrás de mim. Ah, e a torreta de treino continua aqui se precisarem.
The Strong Survive#425.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#426.src: Enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
The Strong Survive#426.dst: Entre na próxima sala e complete o segundo desafio.

The Strong Survive#427.src: Five turrets already? Seems like they're doing things a bit quicker than usual.
The Strong Survive#427.dst: Cinco torretas já? Parece que estão acelerando as coisas mais que o normal.
The Strong Survive#427.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#428.src: Just don't look at it as increased difficulty, instead, look at it is an increased chance to show your might!
The Strong Survive#428.dst: Não veja isso como mais dificuldade, e sim como mais chances de mostrar sua força!
The Strong Survive#428.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#429.src: That wretch... Looking directly at me while he talks about failure...
The Strong Survive#429.dst: Aquele miserável... Olhando bem para mim enquanto fala de fracasso...
The Strong Survive#429.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#430.src: I'll make him eat those words... Maybe not today, but eventually... I'm done with letting people walk all over me!
The Strong Survive#430.dst: Vou fazer ele engolir essas palavras... Talvez não hoje, mas um dia... Chega de deixar que pisem em mim!
The Strong Survive#430.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#431.src: Thank you for being here to listen to me, {u}, I don't know where I'd be right now without you...
The Strong Survive#431.dst: Obrigado por estar aqui me ouvindo, {u}, não sei onde eu estaria agora sem você...
The Strong Survive#431.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#432.src: After this, we'll meet in the cafeteria, and discuss what you saw last night with Adder.
The Strong Survive#432.dst: Depois, a gente se encontra no refeitório e fala do que você viu ontem sobre o Adder.
The Strong Survive#432.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#433.src: Heh... It seems like the instructor had a specific person here in mind when he talked about failures!
The Strong Survive#433.dst: Heh... Parece que o instrutor tinha alguém bem específico em mente quando falou de fracassos!
The Strong Survive#433.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#434.src: When will Arnol realize he can't keep playing pretend soldier?
The Strong Survive#434.dst: Quando o Arnol vai largar essa brincadeira de soldadinho?
The Strong Survive#434.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#435.src: Not this again... I think I can already guess how this will go for me...
The Strong Survive#435.dst: De novo não... Acho que já sei como isso vai acabar para mim...
The Strong Survive#435.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#436.src: Do you think if I duck when the arrow comes, the instructor will count it as a block?
The Strong Survive#436.dst: Será que, se eu me abaixar quando a flecha vier, o instrutor conta como bloqueio?
The Strong Survive#436.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#437.src: Ah the shield challenge... Back when I was a recruit this test was the bane of many of my peers!
The Strong Survive#437.dst: Ah, o desafio do escudo... Quando eu era recruta, essa prova era o terror de muitos colegas!
The Strong Survive#437.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#438.src: It was a lot different back then, yet it seems that it's reputation hasn't changed much. Funny little coincidence I suppose.
The Strong Survive#438.dst: Era bem diferente naquela época, mas parece que a fama não mudou muito. Curiosa coincidência, imagino.
The Strong Survive#438.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#439.src: Alright, {u}, stand on that plate in front of you to start the test.
The Strong Survive#439.dst: Certo, {u}, suba na placa à sua frente para começar a prova.
The Strong Survive#439.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#440.src: Good job recruit, exit through the door across from you.
The Strong Survive#440.dst: Bom trabalho, recruta, saia pela porta à sua frente.
The Strong Survive#440.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#441.src: Leave the challenge room then talk to Arnol and Adder in the cafeteria at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#441.dst: Saia da sala de desafios e fale com Arnol e Adder no refeitório em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#442.src: You're all done now. Was the added difficulty too much? It seemed like it was for your friend Arnol, he stormed out after he finished.
The Strong Survive#442.dst: Pronto, acabou. A dificuldade extra foi demais? Para o seu amigo Arnol pareceu que sim, ele saiu furioso quando terminou.
The Strong Survive#442.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#443.src: That's definitely not how a soldier should act, even I know that! Maybe you can teach him some manners at lunch.
The Strong Survive#443.dst: Não é assim que um soldado age, até eu sei disso! Talvez você possa ensinar bons modos a ele no almoço.
The Strong Survive#443.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#444.src: Anyway, you probably know the drill by now. Head up to the cafeteria and go enjoy your meal.
The Strong Survive#444.dst: Enfim, você já deve saber como funciona. Suba ao refeitório e aproveite a refeição.
The Strong Survive#444.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#445.src: That Wings recruit, Adder, do you know anything about him? Why did he refuse to sit with us?
The Strong Survive#445.dst: Aquele recruta das Asas, o Adder, sabe algo dele? Por que se recusou a sentar com a gente?
The Strong Survive#445.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#446.src: He seems like a complete nobody, I don't think he's from the {p} or Aelumia. I wouldn't bother with him, personally.
The Strong Survive#446.dst: Parece um completo zé-ninguém, acho que não é de {p} nem de Aelumia. Eu, pessoalmente, nem me daria ao trabalho.
The Strong Survive#446.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#447.src: Well I didn't ask for your thoughts on the matter... I just want to know how a complete unknown like him was able to score higher than all of us!
The Strong Survive#447.dst: Ninguém pediu sua opinião... Só quero saber como um completo desconhecido como ele conseguiu pontuar mais que todos nós!
The Strong Survive#447.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#448.src: Two other have been expelled from our friend group... Will I be the next one to go?
The Strong Survive#448.dst: Outros dois já foram expulsos do nosso grupo de amigos... Será que sou a próxima?
The Strong Survive#448.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#449.src: Oh... Dear Queen... Please give me the strength to do well in the training. I can't end up like the others!
The Strong Survive#449.dst: Ah... Querida Rainha... Dê-me forças para ir bem no treino. Não posso acabar como os outros!
The Strong Survive#449.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#450.src: How were you accepted into the Wings division? It's my goal here to be able to become a Wings soldier!
The Strong Survive#450.dst: Como você foi aceito na divisão das Asas? Minha meta aqui é virar soldado das Asas!
The Strong Survive#450.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#451.src: Well honestly, I'm not sure. I guess Recruiter Strumon just saw something in me? I was also stronger than my friends, so maybe that was it.
The Strong Survive#451.dst: Sinceramente, não sei. Acho que o recrutador Strumon viu algo em mim? Eu também era mais forte que meus amigos, talvez seja isso.
The Strong Survive#451.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#452.src: Hmmm... So if I can impress Recruiter Strumon then I might be able to make it into your group?
The Strong Survive#452.dst: Hmmm... Então, se eu impressionar o recrutador Strumon, posso entrar no seu grupo?
The Strong Survive#452.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#453.src: Well not exactly. Recruiter Strumon only accepts recruits. If you want to be promoted into the Wings division as an Aelumia soldier then you'd need to impress a Wings Commander, or Sovereign Majin...
The Strong Survive#453.dst: Não exatamente. O recrutador Strumon só aceita recrutas. Se quiser ser promovido à divisão das Asas como soldado de Aelumia, precisa impressionar um comandante das Asas, ou o Soberano Majin...
The Strong Survive#453.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#454.src: Darn... That sounds harder than I thought it'd be...
The Strong Survive#454.dst: Droga... Parece mais difícil do que eu pensava...
The Strong Survive#454.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#455.src: Did you speak to Recruiter Ollisy about your ranking from yesterday's training, what did she say?
The Strong Survive#455.dst: Falou com a recrutadora Olissy sobre sua colocação no treino de ontem? O que ela disse?
The Strong Survive#455.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#456.src: She assured me that it was not that big of a deal, and I have lots of time to improve. I suppose I was being a bit overdramatic...
The Strong Survive#456.dst: Ela me garantiu que não era nada demais e que tenho muito tempo para melhorar. Acho que eu estava sendo meio dramática...
The Strong Survive#456.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#457.src: In the Fruman military's eyes, we already passed the test. We're all going to be soldiers after the training, the ranking just encourages us to constantly improve.
The Strong Survive#457.dst: Aos olhos do exército de Fruma, já passamos na prova. Todas vamos ser soldadas depois do treino; a classificação só nos incentiva a melhorar sempre.
The Strong Survive#457.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#458.src: That's true, I will use my poor ranking as a reminder that I have much to improve on. I will make sure that today, my ranking will be higher!
The Strong Survive#458.dst: É verdade, vou usar minha má colocação como lembrete de que tenho muito a melhorar. Hoje vou garantir uma colocação melhor!
The Strong Survive#458.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#459.src: I have seen you and Arnol together a lot. I am confused with what you see in him. Is it because of his family name?
The Strong Survive#459.dst: Tenho visto você muito com o Arnol. Não entendo o que vê nele. É por causa do sobrenome?
The Strong Survive#459.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#460.src: If that is the case, I can assure you there are better options. Ones that will not hold you back.
The Strong Survive#460.dst: Se for isso, garanto que há opções melhores. Que não vão te atrasar.
The Strong Survive#460.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#461.src: So... This is how it feels to eat alone at lunch... I hate it...
The Strong Survive#461.dst: Então... é assim almoçar sozinho... Odeio isso...
The Strong Survive#461.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#462.src: These challenges have been so difficult... I wonder if my performance will end up on my record, I hope not...
The Strong Survive#462.dst: Esses desafios estão tão difíceis... Será que meu desempenho vai parar na minha ficha? Espero que não...
The Strong Survive#462.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#463.src: Ha! What am I worried about, this is only the second day of a month of training! I'm sure I will get better before then.
The Strong Survive#463.dst: Ha! Por que me preocupo? É só o segundo dia de um mês de treino! Com certeza vou melhorar até lá.
The Strong Survive#463.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#464.src: This is my third serving, you really ought to take advantage of this buffet! Oh... I hope I don't get a cramp...
The Strong Survive#464.dst: Este é meu terceiro prato, vocês deviam aproveitar esse bufê! Ai... Tomara que eu não tenha cólica...
The Strong Survive#464.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#465.src: Hey, wasn't there someone else in your group, what happened to them?
The Strong Survive#465.dst: Ei, não tinha mais alguém no grupo de vocês? O que houve com ele?
The Strong Survive#465.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#466.src: Eh? I'm not sure, they seemed really jumpy, my guess is they couldn't handle the pressure and wanted to go home.
The Strong Survive#466.dst: Hã? Não sei, parecia muito nervoso; meu palpite é que não aguentou a pressão e quis ir para casa.
The Strong Survive#466.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#467.src: Maybe you should take their example sis. I can tell already that you're struggling to keep up with everyone else!
The Strong Survive#467.dst: Talvez você devesse seguir o exemplo, mana. Já dá para ver que está penando para acompanhar os outros!
The Strong Survive#467.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#468.src: It seems like things are starting to look better for me in these challenges! Maybe if I keep this up, I can manage a spot in the top five!
The Strong Survive#468.dst: Parece que as coisas estão melhorando para mim nesses desafios! Se continuar assim, talvez eu fique entre os cinco primeiros!
The Strong Survive#468.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#469.src: Ah, you're here, {u}, come on, let's go ask Adder about how his duel went yesterday...
The Strong Survive#469.dst: Ah, você chegou, {u}. Vamos perguntar ao Adder como foi o duelo dele ontem...
The Strong Survive#469.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#470.src: Hey there, you're Adder right? I saw that you were first on the ranking yesterday, great job!
The Strong Survive#470.dst: Olá, você é o Adder, né? Vi que ficou em primeiro na classificação ontem, parabéns!
The Strong Survive#470.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#471.src: {u} and I were wondering how the duel went for you yesterday. We erm... Both did poorly on it and wanted to know how you won yours, just tell us what happened during the fight.
The Strong Survive#471.dst: Eu e {u} queríamos saber como foi seu duelo ontem. Nós, hã... fomos mal e queríamos saber como você venceu o seu; conta o que aconteceu na luta.
The Strong Survive#471.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#472.src: You want to know how my duel went yesterday? Well, when it started I didn't engage immediately, I wanted to gauge the strength of my opponent.
The Strong Survive#472.dst: Querem saber como foi meu duelo de ontem? Bem, no começo não ataquei de imediato, queria medir a força do meu oponente.
The Strong Survive#472.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#473.src: Despite leaving myself open for attack many times, my opponent couldn't even land a single hit on me. When I grew tired of that farce, I brutally retaliated...
The Strong Survive#473.dst: Mesmo eu me deixando aberto várias vezes, meu oponente não conseguiu me acertar um golpe sequer. Quando cansei dessa farsa, revidei com brutalidade...
The Strong Survive#473.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#474.src: Even after he was yelling for me to stop, yelling "I yield!" at the top of his lungs, I continued. People like that should not become soldiers.
The Strong Survive#474.dst: Mesmo quando ele gritava para eu parar, berrando "eu me rendo!" a plenos pulmões, continuei. Gente assim não deve virar soldado.
The Strong Survive#474.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#475.src: I stopped after he finally finished yelling, he had to be carried out by two guards. Commander Ferreo was watching the whole time, and did not intervene.
The Strong Survive#475.dst: Parei quando ele enfim parou de gritar; dois guardas tiveram que carregá-lo. O comandante Ferreo assistiu a tudo e não interveio.
The Strong Survive#475.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#476.src: You wanted to know how the duel went, that is how. He never should have been here in the first place, and I did the Fruman military a favour by making sure he will never come back.
The Strong Survive#476.dst: Queriam saber como foi o duelo: foi assim. Ele nunca devia ter vindo, e fiz um favor ao exército de Fruma garantindo que nunca volte.
The Strong Survive#476.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#477.src: You monster... He wanted to dedicate his life to serving the Queen and the people he loved, and you took that all away from him...
The Strong Survive#477.dst: Seu monstro... Ele queria dedicar a vida a servir a Rainha e as pessoas que amava, e você tirou tudo isso dele...
The Strong Survive#477.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#478.src: The will to do something means nothing, no matter how strong it is, if you do not have the ability to do it.
The Strong Survive#478.dst: A vontade de fazer algo não vale nada, por mais forte que seja, se você não tem capacidade para isso.
The Strong Survive#478.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#479.src: He would have just gotten himself killed, or worse, gotten others killed. What I did was serve Fruma to the best of my ability, I am no monster.
The Strong Survive#479.dst: Ele só acabaria morto, ou pior, faria outros morrerem. Eu servi Fruma da melhor forma que pude; não sou nenhum monstro.
The Strong Survive#479.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#480.src: No true soldier would ever intentionally injure an ally... Let's go, {u} this conversation is over.
The Strong Survive#480.dst: Nenhum soldado de verdade feriria um aliado de propósito... Vamos, {u}, essa conversa acabou.
The Strong Survive#480.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#482.src: Are you the one who told him to ask me about that? Who are you exactly?
The Strong Survive#482.dst: Foi você quem mandou ele me perguntar isso? Quem é você, afinal?
The Strong Survive#482.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#483.src: Come sit next to me, I want to discuss what just happened.
The Strong Survive#483.dst: Sente aqui comigo, quero falar do que acabou de acontecer.
The Strong Survive#483.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#484.src: I expected the worst yet was still surprised by that... That fiend really did it on purpose, and Commander Ferreo let it happen...
The Strong Survive#484.dst: Eu esperava o pior e ainda assim me surpreendi... Aquele crápula fez de propósito, e o comandante Ferreo deixou...
The Strong Survive#484.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#485.src: I suppose we should talk about how the shield challenge went. That might end up making me angrier, but I should tell you...
The Strong Survive#485.dst: Acho que devíamos falar de como foi o desafio do escudo. Pode me deixar com mais raiva, mas preciso te contar...
The Strong Survive#485.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#486.src: I started the test, confident, ready to make that instructor eat his words, show him that I am not a failure. And I still couldn't block a single arrow.
The Strong Survive#486.dst: Comecei a prova confiante, pronto para fazer o instrutor engolir o que disse e mostrar que não sou um fracasso. E mesmo assim não bloqueei uma flecha.
The Strong Survive#486.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#487.src: He wouldn't even let me retry it, just told me to leave the room. I protested, I said that wasn't fair, but he insisted...
The Strong Survive#487.dst: Ele nem me deixou tentar de novo, só mandou eu sair da sala. Protestei, disse que não era justo, mas ele insistiu...
The Strong Survive#487.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#488.src: And what about you, how did the shield challenge go?
The Strong Survive#488.dst: E você, como foi no desafio do escudo?
The Strong Survive#488.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#489.src: That's great to hear, maybe you can show me how you did it sometime-
The Strong Survive#489.dst: Que ótimo! Talvez um dia você possa me mostrar como fez-
The Strong Survive#489.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#490.src: I'm sorry to hear about that, we're in this together-
The Strong Survive#490.dst: Sinto muito por isso, estamos juntos nessa-
The Strong Survive#490.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#491.src: I-I was just wondering... No need to get-
The Strong Survive#491.dst: E-eu só estava perguntando... Não precisa-
The Strong Survive#491.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#492.src: Ah, you again... I've decided that I won't be going with you, I have done nothing to deserve such punishment, and will not stand to be treated like this.
The Strong Survive#492.dst: Ah, você de novo... Decidi que não vou com você; não fiz nada para merecer esse castigo e não vou aceitar ser tratado assim.
The Strong Survive#492.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#493.src: Don't talk to him like he's one of your servants, Arnol. Your family name means nothing here, if he asks you to go with him, you must go!
The Strong Survive#493.dst: Não fale com ele como se fosse um dos seus criados, Arnol. Seu sobrenome não vale nada aqui; se ele pede para você ir, você vai!
The Strong Survive#493.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#494.src: This childish tantrum of yours will be noted. Now come with me before you start a scene. You are here to serve us, not the other way around.
The Strong Survive#494.dst: Esse chilique infantil vai ficar registrado. Agora venha comigo antes que faça uma cena. Você está aqui para nos servir, não o contrário.
The Strong Survive#494.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#495.src: Wow, I didn't think Arnol had it in him to talk back to someone like that... Anyway, are you ready for dueling? Follow me.
The Strong Survive#495.dst: Nossa, não achei que o Arnol tivesse coragem de responder alguém assim... Enfim, pronto para os duelos? Me siga.
The Strong Survive#495.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#496.src: Poor Arnol, he's going to become a soldier and yet he still can't control his temper tantrums.
The Strong Survive#496.dst: Coitado do Arnol, vai virar soldado e ainda não controla os próprios chiliques.
The Strong Survive#496.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#497.src: What's next? Is he going to ask Commander Ferreo if he can change his diaper for him?
The Strong Survive#497.dst: Qual é a próxima? Pedir ao comandante Ferreo para trocar a fralda dele?
The Strong Survive#497.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#498.src: Head to the challenge room and recieve instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#498.dst: Vá à sala de desafios e receba as instruções do último desafio do dia em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#499.src: This will be the last of your training for today. Singular melee combat against another recruit.
The Strong Survive#499.dst: Este será o último treino de hoje. Combate individual corpo a corpo contra outro recruta.
The Strong Survive#499.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#500.src: The rules are the same as the day prior. Grab a training sword if you have not from the table and enter the large door when you are ready.
The Strong Survive#500.dst: As regras são as mesmas de ontem. Quem não tem espada de treino, pegue uma na mesa, e entrem pela porta grande quando estiverem prontos.
The Strong Survive#500.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#501.src: I will be unable to oversee your challenges today as there is something I must attend to. I have asked another instructor to do so, they are waiting in the dueling rooms.
The Strong Survive#501.dst: Hoje não poderei supervisionar os desafios, pois tenho um assunto a resolver. Pedi a outro instrutor que o faça; ele espera nas salas de duelo.
The Strong Survive#501.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#502.src: Now go start the duels, good luck recruits.
The Strong Survive#502.dst: Agora vão aos duelos. Boa sorte, recrutas.
The Strong Survive#502.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#503.src: Enter the next room and complete the final challenge of the day.
The Strong Survive#503.dst: Entre na próxima sala e complete o último desafio do dia.

The Strong Survive#504.src: Remember not to take things too seriously here. Being a good soldier is not always about winning.
The Strong Survive#504.dst: Lembre-se de não levar as coisas tão a sério aqui. Ser um bom soldado nem sempre é vencer.
The Strong Survive#504.speaker: Recruiter Alena

The Strong Survive#505.src: Commander Ferreo wants to speak with you, don't keep him waiting.
The Strong Survive#505.dst: O comandante Ferreo quer falar com você, não o deixe esperando.
The Strong Survive#505.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#506.src: Don't tell him I said this, but my brother, Robin, has the advantage over me in this challenge.
The Strong Survive#506.dst: Não conte a ele que eu disse isso, mas meu irmão, Robin, leva vantagem sobre mim nesse desafio.
The Strong Survive#506.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#507.src: As long as I never go up against him though, he won't realize that, that's why I am letting him go on ahead without me.
The Strong Survive#507.dst: Mas, enquanto eu não enfrentar ele, ele não vai perceber; por isso estou deixando ele ir na frente sem mim.
The Strong Survive#507.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#508.src: Maybe if I win against my opponent and he loses, he might be convinced that I am stronger!
The Strong Survive#508.dst: Talvez, se eu vencer meu oponente e ele perder, ele se convença de que sou mais forte!
The Strong Survive#508.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#510.src: I don't want you to start the duel yet, your opponent has yet to arrive. Let's wait together for him.
The Strong Survive#510.dst: Não quero que comece o duelo ainda, seu oponente ainda não chegou. Vamos esperá-lo juntos.
The Strong Survive#510.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#511.src: There you are, Arnol. I was told that you had an outburst during lunch. You will come to know that such things are unacceptable here.
The Strong Survive#511.dst: Aí está você, Arnol. Disseram-me que você teve um ataque no almoço. Vai aprender que isso é inaceitável aqui.
The Strong Survive#511.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#512.src: This is who you'll be dueling against Arnol. You two are friends, yes? Well this duel will surely teach both of you a valuable lesson.
The Strong Survive#512.dst: Este é seu oponente no duelo, Arnol. Vocês dois são amigos, não? Pois este duelo certamente ensinará uma lição valiosa a ambos.
The Strong Survive#512.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#513.src: Valuable lesson? What is that supposed to mean Commander? Is this a trick? What is the point of me dueling my friend?
The Strong Survive#513.dst: Lição valiosa? O que isso quer dizer, comandante? É uma armadilha? Qual o sentido de eu duelar com meu amigo?
The Strong Survive#513.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#514.src: You should know better than to question the orders of your superior, Arnol. Now both of you, into the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#514.dst: Você devia saber que não se questionam as ordens de um superior, Arnol. Agora, os dois, para a sala de duelos.
The Strong Survive#514.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#516.src: Step up, and the duel may begin. If either of you hold back, I will make you start the duel again, as many times as is needed.
The Strong Survive#516.dst: Aproximem-se e que o duelo comece. Se algum de vocês se contiver, farei recomeçar o duelo quantas vezes for preciso.
The Strong Survive#516.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#517.src: You did better than expected Arnol. Yet the result was still what I imagined it would be.
The Strong Survive#517.dst: Você foi melhor do que eu esperava, Arnol. Mas o resultado foi o que imaginei.
The Strong Survive#517.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#518.src: Then what was the point of this duel, if you knew I would lose! Were you trying to humiliate me further? Haven't you done that enough already?!
The Strong Survive#518.dst: Então qual o sentido desse duelo, se sabia que eu ia perder?! Queria me humilhar ainda mais? Já não fez isso o bastante?!
The Strong Survive#518.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#519.src: Your arrogance truly has no bounds. How many punishments will I have to give you until you start to take things here seriously?
The Strong Survive#519.dst: Sua arrogância não tem limites. Quantos castigos terei que dar até você começar a levar isto a sério?
The Strong Survive#519.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#520.src: You're becoming a lost cause, Arnol. Now go, there is something I would like to discuss with {u} in private.
The Strong Survive#520.dst: Você está virando um caso perdido, Arnol. Agora vá, tenho algo a tratar com {u} em particular.
The Strong Survive#520.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#521.src: Your kindness towards him is doing him no favour. Arnol must know what pain is like before he can become stronger, and your friendship is preventing that.
The Strong Survive#521.dst: Sua gentileza com ele não o ajuda em nada. Arnol precisa conhecer a dor antes de ficar mais forte, e a amizade de vocês impede isso.
The Strong Survive#521.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#522.src: For both of your sakes, I insist you sever your bond with him.
The Strong Survive#522.dst: Pelo bem de vocês dois, insisto que corte seus laços com ele.
The Strong Survive#522.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#523.src: Leave the dueling room, then go to the barracks to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#523.dst: Saia da sala de duelos e vá ao quartel dormir em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#524.src: Do not take my advice for granted.
The Strong Survive#524.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#525.src: Am I the only one who is unimpressed with these challenges? They don't seem that related to being a soldier.
The Strong Survive#525.dst: Só eu acho esses desafios nada de mais? Não parecem ter muito a ver com ser soldado.
The Strong Survive#525.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#526.src: Eh, oh well. At least they're kind of fun, I'll give them that. I just wish the other recruits took them less seriously.
The Strong Survive#526.dst: Ah, tanto faz. Pelo menos são meio divertidos, isso eu admito. Só queria que os outros recrutas levassem menos a sério.
The Strong Survive#526.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#527.src: Well done, you kept your promise to get a better ranking! I am sure Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Olissy are proud.
The Strong Survive#527.dst: Muito bem, cumpriu a promessa de subir na classificação! O comandante Ferreo e a recrutadora Olissy vão se orgulhar.
The Strong Survive#527.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#528.src: I used my shame from my first ranking as a driver to try harder on today's challenges. I am happy that I did poorly initially, because now I know I must constantly be trying to improve!
The Strong Survive#528.dst: Usei a vergonha da minha primeira colocação como motivação para me esforçar mais hoje. Fico feliz de ter ido mal no começo, porque agora sei que preciso sempre tentar melhorar!
The Strong Survive#528.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#529.src: I will set the same promise now, tomorrow my ranking will be higher than it is now!
The Strong Survive#529.dst: Faço a mesma promessa agora: amanhã minha colocação vai ser melhor que a de hoje!
The Strong Survive#529.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#530.src: I've failed... Now I'll never be able to become a Wings soldier...
The Strong Survive#530.dst: Eu fracassei... Agora nunca vou virar soldado das Asas...
The Strong Survive#530.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#531.src: Don't you think you're being a bit over dramatic? I think you did great, it's not like you're at the bottom of the ranking.
The Strong Survive#531.dst: Não acha que está exagerando um pouco? Acho que você foi muito bem, não é como se estivesse no fim da classificação.
The Strong Survive#531.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#532.src: Easy for you to say... You're already in the Wings group, you didn't have to work for anything, you were just born good! You'll never know what it's like to be a failure!
The Strong Survive#532.dst: Fácil para você falar... Você já está no grupo das Asas, não precisou ralar por nada, já nasceu bom! Nunca vai saber o que é ser um fracasso!
The Strong Survive#532.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#533.src: I can't believe we're done with the second day already. Enjoy being a recruit while it lasts, it won't get any easier from here.
The Strong Survive#533.dst: Nem acredito que o segundo dia já acabou. Aproveite ser recruta enquanto dura, daqui para frente não fica mais fácil.
The Strong Survive#533.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#534.src: You're on thin ice, Priscilla... You didn't improve at all from yesterday! What will people think if I let a weakling follow me around?
The Strong Survive#534.dst: Você está por um fio, Priscilla... Não melhorou nada desde ontem! O que vão pensar se eu deixar uma fracote andar comigo?
The Strong Survive#534.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#535.src: Please Lynn! Just give me a second chance! I promise I will get into the top {~} tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#535.dst: Por favor, Lynn! Me dê só mais uma chance! Prometo que amanhã entro no top {~}!
The Strong Survive#535.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#536.src: Make it top {~}! And if you fail... I'll never speak to you again!
The Strong Survive#536.dst: Que seja top {~}! E se falhar... nunca mais falo com você!
The Strong Survive#536.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#537.src: Top {~}!? That's... Eh... Fine, I will make it into the top {~} tomorrow, I promise!
The Strong Survive#537.dst: Top {~}?! Isso é... Hã... Tá bom, amanhã eu entro no top {~}, prometo!
The Strong Survive#537.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#538.src: You're not worth my time. Do me a favour and buzz off.
The Strong Survive#538.dst: Você não vale meu tempo. Faça um favor e suma daqui.
The Strong Survive#538.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#539.src: I am willing to put the incident at lunch today aside. You just need to tell me how you or Arnol discovered what happened in my duel on the first day.
The Strong Survive#539.dst: Estou disposto a esquecer o incidente do almoço de hoje. Só precisa me dizer como você ou o Arnol descobriram o que houve no meu primeiro duelo.
The Strong Survive#539.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#540.src: I'm not easily fooled, I don't buy the made up story that you two were looking for advice.
The Strong Survive#540.dst: Não me engano fácil; não caio nessa historinha de que vocês dois queriam conselhos.
The Strong Survive#540.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#541.src: You should take this proposition seriously. I am not the type of person you would want as your enemy.
The Strong Survive#541.dst: Leve essa proposta a sério. Não sou o tipo de pessoa que você quer como inimigo.
The Strong Survive#541.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#542.src: It was a fluke, that's the only explanation of how you were able to beat me by one singular point! It means nothing!
The Strong Survive#542.dst: Foi sorte, é a única explicação para você ter me vencido por um único ponto! Não significa nada!
The Strong Survive#542.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#543.src: Right... Keep telling yourself that, but in the back of your mind you know that I beat you. I'll never make you forget that fact!
The Strong Survive#543.dst: Pode continuar repetindo isso, mas no fundo você sabe que eu te venci. Nunca vou deixar você esquecer!
The Strong Survive#543.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#544.src: They've been at it for a while now. Which one do you think will beat the other tomorrow?
The Strong Survive#544.dst: Estão nessa há um tempão. Quem você acha que vai ganhar do outro amanhã?
The Strong Survive#544.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#545.src: I'm not sure... What do you think will happen if they tie?
The Strong Survive#545.dst: Não sei... O que acha que acontece se empatarem?
The Strong Survive#545.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#546.src: I hope that doesn't happen, they would probably be up all night arguing about who's better.
The Strong Survive#546.dst: Espero que não, eles provavelmente passariam a noite toda discutindo quem é melhor.
The Strong Survive#546.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#547.src: Could this day have gone any worse?
The Strong Survive#547.dst: Tem como esse dia ter sido pior?
The Strong Survive#547.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#548.src: The honourable Commander Ferreo did nothing as Adder beat a fellow recruit to a pulp...
The Strong Survive#548.dst: O honrado comandante Ferreo não fez nada enquanto o Adder espancava um colega...
The Strong Survive#548.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#549.src: The instructors of the esteemed {p} recruit program seem to have no interest in actually training us...
The Strong Survive#549.dst: Os instrutores do renomado programa de recrutas de {p} não parecem querer nos treinar de verdade...
The Strong Survive#549.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#550.src: And I am starting to doubt the idea of bringing honour to my house...
The Strong Survive#550.dst: E estou começando a duvidar dessa história de trazer honra à casa...
The Strong Survive#550.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#551.src: At least I'm not alone though...
The Strong Survive#551.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#552.src: Sneak around to find more information on Commander Ferreo's plans.
The Strong Survive#552.dst: Explore às escondidas em busca de mais informações sobre os planos do comandante Ferreo.

The Strong Survive#553.src: You found all of my diary entries, well done.
The Strong Survive#553.dst: Achou todas as páginas do meu diário. Bom.
The Strong Survive#553.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#554.src: It's been so long since I've hid them, I was beginning to forget about them ever existing.
The Strong Survive#554.dst: Faz tanto tempo que as escondi que eu já estava esquecendo que existiam.
The Strong Survive#554.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#555.src: Don't expect a medal or anything, I can answer some questions that you may have about them though.
The Strong Survive#555.dst: Não espere uma medalha nem nada, mas posso responder algumas perguntas que você tenha sobre elas.
The Strong Survive#555.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#556.src: It was Commander Ferreo's final insult. That's the reason I am here, as a guard in Tericen.
The Strong Survive#556.dst: Foi o último insulto do comandante Ferreo. Por isso estou aqui, como guarda em Tericen.
The Strong Survive#556.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#557.src: After I graduated from the recruit program, my average rankings were seen as too low to join a field Captain or Commander's service.
The Strong Survive#557.dst: Ao fim do programa de recrutas, minha colocação média foi considerada baixa demais para servir a um capitão ou comandante de campo.
The Strong Survive#557.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#558.src: So Ferreo himself stepped up and took me in, stationing me here to waste away. I think it's some form of punishment...
The Strong Survive#558.dst: Então o próprio Ferreo me acolheu e me pôs aqui para apodrecer. Acho que é algum tipo de castigo...
The Strong Survive#558.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#559.src: I'm not sure to be quite honest. Maybe I was hoping for a sly recruit like yourself to find them, and not make the same mistakes I did.
The Strong Survive#559.dst: Para ser sincero, não sei. Talvez eu esperasse que um recruta esperto como você as encontrasse e não cometesse os mesmos erros que eu.
The Strong Survive#559.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#560.src: It may have just been out of boredom though. I can't remember what thoughts were going through my head back when I hid them, after I became a soldier.
The Strong Survive#560.dst: Mas talvez tenha sido só tédio. Não lembro o que passava pela minha cabeça quando as escondi, depois que virei soldado.
The Strong Survive#560.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#561.src: Deep down... Maybe I wanted Commander Ferreo to find those notes. I wonder what he would have thought after reading them...
The Strong Survive#561.dst: No fundo... Talvez eu quisesse que o comandante Ferreo achasse essas notas. O que será que ele teria pensado ao lê-las...
The Strong Survive#561.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#562.src: I had a feeling you'd ask me that. And surprisingly, yes, I did discover the truth about Commander Ferreo's success. There is no secret. He did it all through a fierce determination to become greater.
The Strong Survive#562.dst: Eu sabia que você ia perguntar isso. E, por incrível que pareça, sim, descobri a verdade sobre o sucesso do comandante Ferreo. Não há segredo. Ele conseguiu tudo com uma feroz determinação de crescer.
The Strong Survive#562.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#563.src: When Commander Ferreo was young, he had nothing, he was a vagabond in {p}. Not living, just, surviving.
The Strong Survive#563.dst: Quando jovem, o comandante Ferreo não tinha nada, era um vagabundo em {p}. Não vivia, só... sobrevivia.
The Strong Survive#563.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#564.src: Sometimes the Fruman Military would come to visit, and everyone in the town gathered together to see them. Ferreo saw how everyone loved and praised them for their valiance.
The Strong Survive#564.dst: Às vezes o exército de Fruma vinha visitar, e a cidade toda se reunia para vê-lo. Ferreo via como todos amavam e elogiavam os soldados pela bravura.
The Strong Survive#564.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#565.src: He desperately wanted to be praised and loved like that too. So he made it his goal to reach that position, overcoming the countless obstacles in his way.
The Strong Survive#565.dst: Ele queria desesperadamente ser elogiado e amado assim também. Então decidiu chegar àquela posição, superando os inúmeros obstáculos no caminho.
The Strong Survive#565.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#566.src: Through sheer strength and expertise, he quickly became a Wings Commander, breaking military records in the process.
The Strong Survive#566.dst: Com pura força e perícia, logo virou comandante das Asas, quebrando recordes militares no caminho.
The Strong Survive#566.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#567.src: There were rumours that he would push further and attempt to become a Sovereign, even though all the positions were full at the time...
The Strong Survive#567.dst: Diziam que ele iria além e tentaria se tornar Soberano, embora todos os postos estivessem ocupados na época...
The Strong Survive#567.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#568.src: He had finally reached the level of fame and admiration that he had set out for. But I imagine the potential for even greater heights tormented him.
The Strong Survive#568.dst: Enfim tinha alcançado a fama e a admiração que buscava. Mas imagino que a possibilidade de ir ainda mais alto o atormentava.
The Strong Survive#568.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#569.src: Not many know this, but just before he was given his current position, Commander Ferreo had a meeting with Sovereign Majin and The Queen.
The Strong Survive#569.dst: Poucos sabem, mas pouco antes de receber o cargo atual, o comandante Ferreo se reuniu com o Soberano Majin e a Rainha.
The Strong Survive#569.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#570.src: We can only speculate at what they discussed, but quickly after said meeting, Majin appointed Commander Ferreo as head of {p}. My guess is that he was punished for his ambition...
The Strong Survive#570.dst: Só podemos especular sobre o que discutiram, mas logo depois dessa reunião Majin pôs o comandante Ferreo à frente de {p}. Meu palpite é que foi punido pela ambição...
The Strong Survive#570.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#571.src: Good luck on your training recruit. I recommend you take it more seriously than I did.
The Strong Survive#571.dst: Boa sorte no treinamento, recruta. Recomendo que leve mais a sério do que eu levei.
The Strong Survive#571.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#572.src: Sorry, but I still can't let you enter.
The Strong Survive#572.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#574.src: I grew suspicious of you when I heard you get up in the middle of the night yesterday to sneak around.
The Strong Survive#574.dst: Desconfiei de você quando ouvi você levantar no meio da noite ontem para bisbilhotar.
The Strong Survive#574.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#575.src: And somehow you were able to discover the results of my first duel... The only conclusion I can come to is that you have been spying on Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#575.dst: E de algum jeito você descobriu o resultado do meu primeiro duelo... A única conclusão possível é que você anda espionando o comandante Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#575.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#576.src: For this, you deserve to be exiled, executed, or imprisoned.
The Strong Survive#576.dst: Por isso, você merece o exílio, a execução ou a prisão.
The Strong Survive#576.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#577.src: But... I have been looking to challenge myself, so far the training has been underwhelming. I would like to see what a resistance spy is capable of.
The Strong Survive#577.dst: Mas... eu andava buscando um desafio, e até agora o treino tem sido fraco. Quero ver do que um espião da resistência é capaz.
The Strong Survive#577.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#578.src: If you can best me in a duel, I won't report you to Commander Ferreo. The first person to land {~} hits on the other shall be declared the victor.
The Strong Survive#578.dst: Se me vencer num duelo, não vou te denunciar ao comandante Ferreo. Quem acertar {~} golpes no outro primeiro será declarado vencedor.
The Strong Survive#578.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#579.src: As a show of good faith, I will let you land the first hit on me.
The Strong Survive#579.dst: Como prova de boa-fé, deixo você me acertar o primeiro golpe.
The Strong Survive#579.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#580.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry particles, Adder will swipe his estoc at you. Perfect blocking this attack will stun him, allowing you to counterattack.
The Strong Survive#580.dst: Anunciado por um grunhido e partículas de raiva, Adder golpeia você com o estoque. Um bloqueio perfeito deste ataque o atordoa e permite contra-atacar.
The Strong Survive#580.speaker: Swipe

The Strong Survive#581.src: Telegraphed by a grunt without angry particles, Adder will hop to the side.
The Strong Survive#581.dst: Anunciado por um grunhido sem partículas de raiva, Adder salta para o lado.
The Strong Survive#581.speaker: Sidestep

The Strong Survive#582.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry and blue particles, Adder will lunge forward and charge with his estoc. This attack deals damage twice, once at the start and once at the peak of the lunge. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#582.dst: Anunciado por um grunhido e partículas de raiva e azuis, Adder vai avançar e investir com o estoque. Este ataque causa dano duas vezes: no início e no auge da estocada. Um bloqueio perfeito do último golpe o atordoa.
The Strong Survive#582.speaker: Lunge

The Strong Survive#583.src: Telegraphed by angry and green particles, Adder will continuously swipe his estoc in front of him while running towards the {u} for several seconds. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#583.dst: Anunciado por partículas de raiva e verdes, Adder vai golpear sem parar com o estoque enquanto corre em direção a {u} por vários segundos. Um bloqueio perfeito do último golpe o atordoa.
The Strong Survive#583.speaker: Swipe Chain

The Strong Survive#584.src: Absurd... Even after everything I have been through, I still am not strong enough...
The Strong Survive#584.dst: Absurdo... Mesmo depois de tudo o que passei, ainda não sou forte o bastante...
The Strong Survive#584.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#586.src: Make your way through the vents.

The Strong Survive#587.src: We've found ourselves in a terribly difficult situation, Strumon...
The Strong Survive#587.dst: Estamos numa situação terrivelmente difícil, Strumon...
The Strong Survive#587.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#588.src: We have a spy amongst our recruits and know who they are, yet that messenger expects us to not do anything about it until Sovereign Majin gets here!?
The Strong Survive#588.dst: Temos um espião entre os recrutas e sabemos quem é, e aquele mensageiro espera que não façamos nada até o Soberano Majin chegar?!
The Strong Survive#588.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#589.src: I think it is important to be cautious here Commander, if this spy is as powerful as the messenger implied... This could spell the end for all of us...
The Strong Survive#589.dst: Acho importante ter cautela, comandante. Se esse espião é tão poderoso quanto o mensageiro deu a entender... pode ser o fim de todos nós...
The Strong Survive#589.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#590.src: Yes, you're probably right. Nevertheless, once Sovereign Majin arrives and sees that I let a spy into the recruit program... I fear that all that I have worked for will be lost...
The Strong Survive#590.dst: Sim, provavelmente tem razão. Mesmo assim, quando o Soberano Majin chegar e vir que deixei um espião entrar no programa de recrutas... temo perder tudo pelo que trabalhei...
The Strong Survive#590.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#591.src: I will not give up so easily, nor will I do nothing while we wait for Sovereign Majin to arrive...
The Strong Survive#591.dst: Não vou desistir tão fácil, nem ficar de braços cruzados esperando o Soberano Majin chegar...
The Strong Survive#591.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#592.src: I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
The Strong Survive#592.dst: Quero Effal exilado para Wynn imediatamente por traição. Ele deixou o espião entrar e deve ser punido. Arranje um guarda para substituí-lo como recrutador; qualquer um seria mais competente.
The Strong Survive#592.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#593.src: Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#593.dst: Repasse isso aos outros guardas e recrutadores. Effal tem que sair de Fruma até amanhã!
The Strong Survive#593.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#594.src: Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
The Strong Survive#594.dst: Agora, comandante, há outro assunto que eu gostaria de tratar, o motivo de eu ter vindo à sua sala tão tarde da noite.
The Strong Survive#594.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#595.src: Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
The Strong Survive#595.dst: Seu plano de ontem correu perfeitamente. Falei com o médico e ele disse que vão ter que mandar Katze para casa.
The Strong Survive#595.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#596.src: Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
The Strong Survive#596.dst: Excelente. Amanhã o Adder vai duelar com o Arnol. O sobrenome dele não vai mais compensar sua fraqueza!
The Strong Survive#596.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#597.src: Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
The Strong Survive#597.dst: Comandante... É mesmo a melhor opção? O espião parece ter se afeiçoado ao Arnol. Temo que isso provoque uma retaliação...
The Strong Survive#597.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#598.src: Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
